meta.va_rule: VA = image_base + vaddr + (fileoff - rptr); .rdata: VA=fileoff+0xA00; .reloc: VA=fileoff+0x16B600
meta.confidence_rule: high = exactly one entity explains >=60% of cluster 4CCs (containment>=0.6, runner-up<0.6); medium = >=0.3 or ambiguous top; low otherwise
notes: clusters[] built from PRIMARY c7 mov-imm patterns only (commander spec); spans use instruction-start offsets (c7 45 f0 ...)
aux idioms (push/mov-r32/cmp) used only to locate entity codes; filtered to entity-code 4CCs
dispatch_switches spans use opcode-start offsets (81 xx imm32 => opcode at imm-2)
hits[] has every primary raw hit (instruction start + imm offset + shape + 4CC) for byte-level verification
